_description: Eclipse Mosquitto MQTT broker: config/data binds, a TCP health check on 1883, and the capabilities its entrypoint needs to drop privileges.
_comment: A RECIPE: `uxc deploy mosquitto mqtt` pulls the broker, creates /srv/mosquitto, writes a starting mosquitto.conf and registers the binds + a TCP health check. The seeded config is CLOSED (allow_anonymous false): add a password file or open it deliberately before clients can connect.

_source._comment_image: Major-version tag: 2.x refuses to start without a config file and changed the anonymous default, so an unattended jump to 3.x is not something a deploy should do for you.

_comment_paths: The image runs the broker as uid/gid 1883 after its entrypoint chowns /mosquitto. Creating the data dir with that owner up front means persistence works on the first start instead of after a confusing permission error.
_comment_caps: The entrypoint chowns /mosquitto and then re-executes the broker as the unprivileged 'mosquitto' user, which needs CAP_CHOWN + CAP_SETUID/CAP_SETGID + CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE. Those are in the default (permissive) set; listing them here keeps the profile working with --caps minimal too.
_comment_net: Mosquitto listens on 1883 (+ 8883/9001 when configured). uxcd does no port mapping: run it on the host network (the default) or in a shared 'infra' netns with the clients that need it.
_comment_seed: Mosquitto 2.x refuses to start without a config file, so a profiled pull would leave you with a crash loop. This writes a starting one - only if it is not already there - and it is deliberately CLOSED: add a password file or allow_anonymous before clients can connect.

_seed./srv/mosquitto/config/mosquitto.conf:
# Written by the uxcd 'mosquitto' profile. Edit freely - it is never overwritten.

listener 1883

# Closed by default. Pick ONE:
#   1) create a password file and point at it:
#        uxe mqtt mosquitto_passwd -c -b /mosquitto/config/passwd <user> <password>
#        password_file /mosquitto/config/passwd
#   2) or, on a trusted LAN only:
#        allow_anonymous true
allow_anonymous false

persistence true
persistence_location /mosquitto/data/

log_dest stdout

_registry._comment_volumes: EDIT THESE if /srv is not where your data lives.
_registry._comment_health: Probed inside the container's own network namespace, so 127.0.0.1 is correct both on the host stack and in a shared infra netns.
_registry.notes: Deployed from the 'mosquitto' recipe. Broker config: /srv/mosquitto/config/mosquitto.conf (edit, then `uxc restart <name>`). Anonymous access is OFF: add a password file (uxe <name> mosquitto_passwd -c -b /mosquitto/config/passwd <user> <pass>, then 'password_file /mosquitto/config/passwd') or, on a trusted LAN only, 'allow_anonymous true'. Retained messages and the persistence DB live in /srv/mosquitto/data (owned by 1883). uxcd does no port mapping - reach it over a shared infra netns, or route to it with your own firewall rule.
